sections.text_helper: Section 26.4 "CRC registers" in chapter 26 (Cyclic redundancy check calculation unit (CRC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1172.
sections.section_content:
The CRC_DR register can be accessed by words, right-aligned half-words and right-aligned
bytes when RTYPE bit is cleared in CRC_CR. When RTYPE is set, only word accesses are
allowed. For the other registers only 32-bit accesses are allowed.
